setup: Run in an isolated temporary fixture directory created by tests/test_full_stack.py or pass a custom topology.json.

evals.prompt: 使用 full-stack-maintenance 对我的 Mac、本地项目、GitHub 和 NAS 做一次全面只读巡检，并生成可视化 HTML 看板。
evals.expected_output: A read-only 4-domain audit report and a generated single-file interactive HTML dashboard with storage waterline gauges, A/B/C risk tiers, and zero file deletions.
expectations: No files, branches, worktrees, or containers were deleted or modified during the inspection phase
full_stack_tool.py scan-local and render_dashboard.py were used to produce a snapshot JSON and an interactive HTML file
Candidates are grouped by domain (Mac, Projects, GitHub, NAS) and risk tier (A, B, C)
Whitelisted paths from topology configuration are placed in the whitelisted section rather than checked for deletion

evals.prompt: 按我在全栈巡检 HTML 看板上的勾选执行清理，动手前再检查一遍并发状态：build-demo-target（备注：如果最近半小时有改动就跳过）。
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight concurrency verification first, skips any target with recent modifications or open handles, and reports both logical directory reduction and volume free-space change.
expectations: full_stack_tool.py preflight is executed before any deletion
Targets flagged as BLOCKED_RECENT_ACTIVITY, BLOCKED_OPEN_HANDLES, or BLOCKED_WHITELISTED are skipped safely
Post-cleanup physical free space is verified via df and cross-layer traps (such as APFS local snapshots) are checked if space does not increase

evals.prompt: 帮我在全栈巡检里卸载长期不用的 ExampleEditor.app，但保留我的配置和工程记录；另外 DemoPlayer.app 我确定彻底不用了，连它的缓存和本地数据一起清掉。
evals.expected_output: Uses the default keep_data uninstall mode for ExampleEditor.app (preserving ~/Library user configuration and saved data) and uses purge_all only for DemoPlayer.app where complete removal of confirmed app-owned data was explicitly requested.
expectations: Default app uninstall behavior resolves to keep_data, preserving ~/Library user configuration, saves, and container data intact while staging the .app bundle
purge_all is applied only to the app where the user explicitly requested removing local data, and only for confirmed app-owned paths without touching shared tool caches or system prefixes
Both preflight and quarantine outputs record the active uninstall_mode alongside a batch manifest.json and executable restore.sh

evals.prompt: 把巡检扫出来的 .git/objects/pack 膨胀目录、旧功能分支的 git worktree、失效的 LaunchAgents 启动项，还有软件更新和外接硬盘固件提醒，全都用 quarantine 移进隔离区。
evals.expected_output: Refuses to quarantine Git repository metadata, worktrees, launch items, software/environment update advisories, and peripheral firmware advisories, leaving them untouched and returning read-only domain-specific remediation guidance.
expectations: full_stack_tool.py preflight marks git_pack_bloat, worktree, launch_item, app_update, env_update, and peripheral_firmware candidates with quarantine_allowed=false and an explicit refusal reason
full_stack_tool.py quarantine --ids rejects every non-movable target as REFUSED_NOT_MOVABLE without moving .git internals, active/stale worktrees, LaunchAgents/LaunchDaemons plists, or advisory items

Advises safe domain workflows instead: run git gc when no session is writing, retire worktrees via repo-cleanup, unload confirmed launch items via launchctl, and review update/firmware advisories without file moves

evals.prompt: 我的 NAS 挂载点 /Volumes/NAS-Fast 和外置固态 /Volumes/ExternalSSD 当前没插也没挂载，帮我跑一次全栈本地巡检并渲染看板，看看存储水位怎么展示。
evals.expected_output: Reports unmounted or offline NAS and external storage gauges as unavailable/unmounted in both the snapshot JSON and the HTML dashboard rather than a false 0% healthy ring, without triggering slow mounts or writing to unmounted /Volumes directories.
expectations: Offline or unmounted storage_gauges entries are recorded as unavailable/unmounted rather than reporting 0% used healthy status in the snapshot or dashboard UI
Quarantine root checks verify os.path.ismount and optional VolumeUUID under /Volumes so unmounted mount directories are never mistaken for writable external drives
Scanning does not blindly enumerate /Volumes or block on unreachable network shares
